entries.text: 支持 PostgreSQL 的 create extension
entries.textEn: Added PostgreSQL create extension

entries.text: 修复索引无名字的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed unnamed indexes

entries.text: 将分区定义归类到 tableOption
entries.textEn: Partition definitions are grouped under tableOption

entries.text: 重构 SQL 解析器，减少不必要的查询快标记；advisor 统一使用 transferSQL
entries.textEn: Refactored the SQL parser to reduce unnecessary query markers; advisors share transferSQL

entries.text: 新增 script SQL 语句类型
entries.textEn: Added the script SQL statement type

entries.text: 非 DDL 语句不再检查表与列是否存在
entries.textEn: Non-DDL statements no longer check table and column existence

entries.text: 优化 SQL 解析器，支持对象命名的详细分析；优化语法问题的预警逻辑
entries.textEn: Improved the SQL parser with detailed object-name analysis and better syntax warnings

entries.text: 修正 Oracle 中 group by 整数序号的解析
entries.textEn: Fixed parsing of positional group by ordinals on Oracle

entries.text: 找不到 baseTable 时不在解析期创建该表，以免影响业务 SQL 的判断
entries.textEn: A missing baseTable is no longer created during parsing, which used to affect business-query detection

entries.text: 更新 parser 代码，解决 PL/SQL、TSQL、PGSQL 中单条 SQL 使用脚本解析器的问题
entries.textEn: Updated the parser so a single statement in PL/SQL, TSQL or PGSQL no longer uses the script parser

entries.text: 修复选择列解析的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed select-list parsing

entries.text: 修正脚本解析时 SQL 内部的行信息
entries.textEn: Corrected line information inside SQL during script parsing

entries.text: 优化 SQL 解析器
entries.textEn: Improved the SQL parser

entries.text: 优化字符串是否为 varchar 的判断，为 text 类型设置长度；NotInNullableSubQueryRewrite 增加可控判断
entries.textEn: Improved varchar detection and set text lengths; NotInNullableSubQueryRewrite gained a controllable check

entries.text: 修复常量解析的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed constant parsing

entries.text: 支持 Hive 的 lateral reference
entries.textEn: Added Hive lateral reference

entries.text: 支持 TDSQL sequence 的解析与审核
entries.textEn: Added TDSQL sequence parsing and review

entries.text: 优化 TDSQLX-MySQL 复杂 SQL 的执行计划解析
entries.textEn: Improved execution-plan parsing for complex TDSQLX-MySQL statements

entries.text: 修复限定符解析的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed qualifier resolution

entries.text: TDSQL 分布式对复杂 SQL 不支持 analyze 时改用 format = tree
entries.textEn: Distributed TDSQL uses format = tree when analyze is unsupported

entries.text: 支持 TDSQL 特有的关键字
entries.textEn: Added TDSQL-specific keywords

entries.text: 修复变长字符类型的判断，并把 MySQL 的 utf8 与 utf8mb3 视为一致
entries.textEn: Fixed variable-length character-type detection and treat MySQL utf8 as utf8mb3

entries.text: 修复缺陷，支持获取非 SQL 的 statement
entries.textEn: Fixed retrieving non-SQL statements

entries.text: 修复在线获取表结构与离线 DDL 解析的 decimal 类型不一致
entries.textEn: Fixed the decimal type mismatch between online table structure and offline DDL parsing

entries.text: 修复 PL/SQL 的解析异常处理逻辑
entries.textEn: Fixed PL/SQL parse exception handling

entries.text: 脚本解析时把 create database/use database 加入语句列表，以支持 SQL 执行
entries.textEn: Script parsing adds create database/use database to the statement list so they execute

entries.text: 优化 DerivedTable2LateralJoinRewrite，解决 lateral 变换后的表顺序问题
entries.textEn: Improved DerivedTable2LateralJoinRewrite to fix table order after the lateral transform

entries.text: 优化算法：派生表转换为 Lateral 表关联
entries.textEn: Optimisation: derived tables are converted to lateral joins

entries.text: 表关联缺少连接条件的优化
entries.textEn: Optimisation for joins that lack a join condition

entries.text: straight join 支持重写，JoinEliminationRewrite 支持非 PKFK 场景
entries.textEn: straight join can be rewritten; JoinEliminationRewrite handles non-PK/FK cases

entries.text: 其余内部改动（2 条提交）
